text:
maria_ops: proposing a small experiment for preemptible GPU evictions — instead of immediate token cutover we do a ‘soft-lease’ transfer + short requeue window (8s) and a lightweight checkpoint push to object storage. keeps streaming tails intact and avoids head-of-line failures for short evicts. thoughts? :thinking_face:

rohit_eng: sounds promising. do you have a sketch of the flow? curious about failure modes if the checkpoint push gets throttled.

maria_ops: sketch below. goal is to make the runtime tolerant for <15s evicts (most cloud preempt) while still failing fast for long evicts.

maria_ops: ```yaml
soft_lease_ms: 8000
requeue_window_ms: 10000
checkpoint_backend: s3://inference-checkpoints/soft-lease/{{node_id}}/
stream_token_transfer: ephemeral-signed-url
max_retries: 3
backoff_ms: 250,500,1000
```

chen_runtime: a few notes: 1) need idempotent resume on client side (hold stream seq id), 2) KV cache snapshot should be per-prefix to avoid large blobs, 3) add a circuit-breaker for checkpoint pressure.

alex_sre: from SLO POV we still need guaranteed 99th latency under 200ms for non-streaming calls. does soft-lease add latency? if we keep it local until checkpoint confirms it might.

maria_ops: aim is no added latency for active requests. soft-lease only triggers when eviction notice arrives. we do immediate local transfer of ephemeral token to a neighbor pod (same AZ if possible) and start async checkpoint push. requests see a short requeue if token exchange is mid-token. typical impact: a 1-2 token hiccup, not full response restart.

sara_infra: region note — in ap-southeast some preempt windows are noisier. recommend AZ-aware neighbor selection + fallback to dedicated pool if >X% preempt rate.

rohit_eng: what about throttling: if S3 starts rejecting because of hot small writes, we can fallback to a lighter durability mode: push metadata to redis and async offload later. tradeoff: longer resume window but lower write QPS.

maria_ops: exactly. flow has tiers: 1) best-effort quick snapshot to S3 for immediate resume, 2) if S3 throttled -> metadata to cluster redis (fast), mark resume_pending, 3) eventual bulk upload by background worker.

tom_runtime: question on client requeue logic — do we ask clients to retry idempotently or do we return a custom 409-like hint so SDK auto-requeues? I prefer SDK-level auto-retry with jitter so apps don't need to change.

chen_runtime: SDK auto-retry is fine but must expose stream sequence token to clients and provide clear semantics: resume vs restart. we should document 'resume' header and how to detect irreversible loss.

alex_sre: add Prometheus metrics: preempt_soft_lease_count, soft_lease_failures, resume_latency_histogram, checkpoint_backend_errors. we need alert when resume failures spike.

maria_ops: agreed. I added a lightweight dashboard mock: preempt events by AZ, percent resumed successfully, avg resume latency, cost delta (requests saved by resume).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: soft-lease-controller v0.1 -> staging at sha@c3a9f2. rollout plan: 10% canaries in us-west-2 for 4h, then 50% for 2h, then full.

rohit_eng: tentative canary checks: resume success > 98% and no >2x increase in 99th latency for non-streaming. if either fails, rollback.

sara_infra: cost note — this will increase small-object writes to S3 and Redis ops. rough estimate: 0.4% more storage egress and +1% infra ops on mixed pools. still cheaper than moving traffic to dedicated GPUs for short tail evicts.

maria_ops: next steps: 1) implement controller + SDK resume header (chen), 2) infra: AZ neighbor pickup policy + redis fallback (sara), 3) SRE: dashboard and alerts (alex), 4) canary config and rollback criteria (rohit). aiming for staging deploy today.

chen_runtime: I'll draft SDK changes and a tiny protocol doc.

alex_sre: I'll add alerts and the SLO gating checks to the canary job.

sara_infra: prepping redis namespaces and IAM for the checkpoint bucket.

rohit_eng: I'll own rollback automation and canary traffic shaping.

maria_ops: thanks all. I'll post the design doc in #eng-runtime after lunch and link the staging job. :rocket:
